description: The Government of Rajasthan launches a free, bilingual AI Foundational Course for citizens, offering self-paced learning and a government-recognized certificate.
body_lead: The Government of Rajasthan, through the Department of Information Technology & Communication (DoIT&C), has announced the launch of its Official AI Foundational Course, an initiative aimed at empowering citizens with essential Artificial Intelligence (AI) skills and preparing them for the rapidly evolving digital and technology-driven future. As AI continues to transform workplaces, businesses, education and public services, developing foundational AI competencies has become increasingly important.
